name: Genex recommendations
description: Genex's own optional advice for making games: multiplayer patterns, cover craft, where assets can come from and shop design. Skills an agent reads on demand; none of it is required.

skills.name: multiplayer-patterns
skills.summary: Optional patterns for a multiplayer web game on @genex-ai/multiplayer: choosing connect or matchmake, menus and lobbies, teams, quorum, reconnects, testing with two players, and per-genre setups.

skills.name: cover-craft
skills.summary: Optional advice on making a Genex cover picture and clip: choosing the moment, framing for 16:9, working with the game's own light, and comparing a few candidates.

skills.name: asset-sources
skills.summary: Optional advice on where a game's assets can come from (Local Blender, Genex's lanes, code) and how to plan a small asset set.

skills.name: shop-design
skills.summary: Optional advice on a shop players want to buy from on Genex, and on compliant alternatives when a request crosses Genex's hard rules.
